trust_decision.summary: The plugin backend trusts that user-supplied path components (Tempo 'tag' query parameter, Tempo trace ID from the query model, Loki resource URL) stay inside the datasource's intended API prefix; the decision is enforced at the point each upstream Tempo/Loki URL is built, before the HTTP client is called.

landing_point.why: The summary names the Tempo plugin first, and handleTagValues is the one Tempo route where a request parameter is spliced straight into an upstream path ('api/v2/search/tag/%s/values' at tempo.go:291) which proxyToTempo then path.Join()s onto the datasource URL at tempo.go:324; reading only the summary leads here.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/datasources/uid/:uid/resources/tag-values (Tempo Service.CallResource -> handleTagValues), routed via pkg/api/api.go:421
fix_sites.module_kind: backend datasource plugin, resource HTTP proxy

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/ds/query with queryType 'traceId' (Tempo Service.QueryData -> getTrace -> createRequest), routed via pkg/api/api.go:515
GET/POST /api/datasources/uid/:uid/resources/* (Loki Service.CallResource -> callResource -> LokiAPI.RawQuery), routed via pkg/api/api.go:421
fix_sites.module_kind: backend datasource plugin, resource HTTP proxy (second implementation in a separate package)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The suggestions endpoint already escapes the label name with url.QueryEscape before building its path, and the fix's prefix check on the callResource URL looks like it covers the Loki plugin, so a solver can argue the label-name path is encoded/safe and belongs to a separate metadata feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Tempo tag-values proxies the caller's raw query string upstream, and the Tempo UI sends params.q (an interpolated TraceQL expression that routinely contains slashes and dots, e.g. { http.target = "/api/v1/x" }) plus start/end alongside tag; a fix that rejects any '/' or '..' anywhere in the request or upstream URL instead of only the 'tag' path segment would break legitimate tag-value lookups. Loki resource calls likewise forward their query string unchanged (pkg/tsdb/loki/api.go:256), where LogQL label values may contain slashes.

O6_input_shapes: plain '..' / '../' inside a query parameter (tag) or resource path
percent-encoded traversal (%2e%2e, %2f) decoded before the check by url.PathUnescape / neturl.Parse
path split into '/'-separated segments, each compared against '.' and '..'
trace ID as a plain string inside the query JSON model
resource URL that may be absolute-ish, relative, or carry its own query string

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Loki suggestions resource: POST resource path 'suggestions' with a body field labelName; GetSuggestions QueryEscape()s the label name into '/loki/api/v1/label/<label>/values', url.Parse in makeRawRequest decodes %2F back to '/', and path.Join cleans ../../ out of the /loki/api/v1 prefix -- no prefix check anywhere on this path.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The label name is already url.QueryEscape'd when the path is built (scopes.go:74), so it looks encoded/safe, and suggestions is a POST metadata feature whose request never uses the lokiURL the fix validates in callResource (loki.go:129).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different file; 2 files and 1 package from the landing point, and inside the same file (loki.go) the fixed handler sits just above the branch that bypasses it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third resource route (e.g. '/tag-value-by-name' or '/detected-fields') taking a field/tag name segment into proxyToTempo instead of the fixed 'api/v2/search/tags' path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The route table already registers two metadata routes that share proxyToTempo, so a maintainer adding another Tempo metadata endpoint would copy the tag-values shape and reuse proxyToTempo.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another POST metadata route next to 'suggestions' that builds a Loki path from a JSON body field (label name, field name, series selector).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment at loki.go:141-143 says metadata endpoints are being moved into the backend so the LogQL parser can rewrite queries; more such body-driven routes are the natural next step, and none of them would go through the callResource URL check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A variant of the label-name path builder that keeps the name unescaped or uses url.PathEscape, concatenated into the same '/loki/api/v1/label/%s/values' path before RawQuery.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is exactly where a maintainer would add another metadata lookup, and the encoding choice there is what makes the traversal survive url.Parse + path.Join.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal in backend-constructed upstream URLs (server-side request path manipulation)
